const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Episode controller for the MolmoSpaces remote-to-orange-dish task.
+
+The live episode has already been executed and recorded by the service. This
+script preserves the pose-based action sequence used for that episode; when
+run against the same client after completion it exits without sending motion.
+"""
+
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+DT = 0.132  # two 15.152 Hz control periods
+GRASP_ORIENTATION = [0.0, 0.47252282, 0.88131844, 0.0]
+DISH_ORIENTATION = [0.0, 0.07609900, 0.99710000, 0.0]
+
+
+def move_pose(robot, xyz, quat, gripper, rows=12, settle=4):
+    obs = robot.get_obs()
+    q0 = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7], dtype=float)
+    ik = robot.ik({"gripper": list(xyz) + list(quat)}, seed=q0.tolist())
+    if not ik.get("ok"):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed for {xyz}: {ik}")
+    q1 = np.asarray(ik["q"], dtype=float)
+    actions = [np.r_[q0 * (1 - t) + q1 * t, gripper]
+               for t in np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, rows)]
+    actions.extend([np.r_[q1, gripper]] * settle)
+    return robot.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=DT, video="none")
+
+
+def set_gripper(robot, command, rows=8):
+    obs = robot.get_obs()
+    q = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7], dtype=float)
+    return robot.submit("joint_position", [np.r_[q, command]] * rows,
+                        dt=DT, video="none")
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    if robot.status().get("done"):
+        print("The recorded episode is already complete; no motion sent.")
+        return
+
+    # Camera/depth estimate for this episode: remote near (2.652, 6.998),
+    # orange basin near (2.544, 6.836), in the house world frame.
+    move_pose(robot, [2.652, 6.998, 0.96], GRASP_ORIENTATION, 0)
+    move_pose(robot, [2.652, 6.998, 0.807], GRASP_ORIENTATION, 0,
+              rows=10, settle=5)
+    set_gripper(robot, 255)
+    move_pose(robot, [2.652, 6.998, 0.94], GRASP_ORIENTATION, 255,
+              rows=10, settle=5)
+
+    # The measured grasp offset is compensated so the remote center lands at
+    # the dish basin center; the dish's long axis is approximately world -X.
+    move_pose(robot, [2.577, 6.856, 0.94], DISH_ORIENTATION, 255,
+              rows=12, settle=4)
+    move_pose(robot, [2.5786, 6.8552, 0.86], DISH_ORIENTATION, 255,
+              rows=10, settle=5)
+    set_gripper(robot, 0)
+    move_pose(robot, [2.5786, 6.8552, 0.99], DISH_ORIENTATION, 0,
+              rows=10, settle=4)
+    robot.submit("done", [])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
